grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before accessing your tax and pension records

grants.description: Access your HMRC tax records to calculate your tax liability
grants.purpose: To determine whether you owe tax on your pension and calculate the amount

grants.description: Access details of your State Pension and private pension income
grants.purpose: To calculate total pension income for tax liability assessment

grants.description: Declare other taxable income including employment, benefits, and investments
grants.purpose: To calculate total annual income and determine overall tax liability

revocation.mechanism: Revoke consent through your GOV.UK account or contact HMRC
revocation.effect: Calculation will be cancelled. You will need to contact HMRC directly to discuss your tax liability.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make tax payments on your behalf. Agent cannot change your tax code or Personal Allowance. Agent cannot submit Self Assessment returns. Agent cannot access records if you have foreign income, Marriage Allowance, or Blind Person's Allowance (these require human HMRC advisor).
